generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of home first aid (家庭急救). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph an open first-aid storage box on a clean kitchen table from a natural three-quarter overhead angle, not a flat-lay catalogue. Use the open lid to occupy the upper third and arrange the nine supplies in realistic compartments and on the table edge, each appearing once with clear space around it. Keep the gauze pad, wipe, elastic wrap, tape and burn dressing visually distinct by shape and packaging; unfold the gloves but leave them empty, and keep the scissors closed. Soft window light, ordinary home setting, no person, injury, blood, medicine branding or readable packaging text.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: first-aid storage box, sterile gauze pad, antiseptic wipe, medical elastic wrap, medical adhesive tape, medical tweezers, instant cold pack, disposable medical gloves, first-aid safety scissors, burn dressing.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
